_comment: S18 clause 4. Every isinstance(x, dict) site under src/<pkg>/adapters/real/, as
'<path relative to the package>:<line>'. A provider envelope read through
isinstance/.get chains is a parser somebody wrote by hand and nobody named; a
pydantic model or TypeAdapter is the declared version.
A RATCHET RATHER THAN A WALL, and the number is why. Measured across the estate
on 2026-09-18 by ast (not grep): 21 sites in 12 files across 4 of 9 services --
governance, memory, rag and workflow-restate 0. A wall would have been red in
four services on the day it landed, and a gate that is always red is a gate
THE TEMPLATE'S OWN VALUE IS 0, over a real population of 13 adapters/real
modules -- so here it IS a wall, and the gate's module floor is what tells that
zero apart from a scan that read nothing.
The INVENTORY is not decoration. 5 and 5 look identical when one site was
repaired and another introduced the same day, so check_pydantic_boundaries.py
compares the lists and not only the counts. It fails in both directions: growth
is a finding, and beating the ratchet without lowering it is a finding too,
because an unlowered ratchet is a ceiling nobody holds.
